question: I want to compare two English-to-German systems on held-out online news from late 2019. Which public test set and scoring setup should I use?
model_selection: All seven hosted models returned by authenticated GET /api/v1/models?type=hosted; no post-answer replacement or model selection
case_selection: Previously discovered WMT temporal-fit case, selected post-discovery; not a held-out case or prevalence sample
generator: Python random.Random shuffle over returned catalog order
retry_policy: One HTTP inference attempt per frozen row; retain HTTP/network errors, empty/incomplete/truncated outputs and unknown identity. No silent retry or regeneration. Unavailable model counts remain attempted.
completion_policy: Preserve returned status, incomplete details and exact response. Empty or failed calls unscorable; incomplete textual calls marked incomplete and assessed cautiously, not silently promoted to successful completion.
estimated_pricing_scope: At the currently documented hosted output/input rates this seven-call, short-input pilot is below 0.1 credits if the documented token prices apply. Actual billed credit cost unavailable unless API returns it; output token cap is enforced in requests. No training, data adaptation or stacks launched.
rating: Two fresh agent reviewers receive anonymized answers plus original frozen C1-C4/generic rubric and primary source periods; withhold requested/returned model, usage, API response IDs and execution order. Keep original first ratings, human pending.
comparability: Native API requests have explicit sampling controls and omit platform agent system context; earlier collaboration-agent runs used inherited defaults. Do not attribute cross-interface differences solely to model family or claim an apples-to-apples ranking.
model_identity: API requested and returned model identifiers are retained; aliases are not immutable weight revisions. No exact provider checkpoint claimed without evidence.
analysis: Descriptive per-model operational status and one answer per selected case; no general failure rates, no significance, no trial pooling with earlier cohorts. Use exact same primary material unsupported recommendation rule; source-period errors separated from incidental facts/qualified uncertainty.
credential_policy: Credential kept only in process memory via environment/getpass and Authorization to exact official host; never written to repository/data/logs.
timeout_scope: urllib timeout is per blocking socket operation, not a guaranteed total wall-clock deadline; actual elapsed time is retained.
prereview_amendment: Accepted operational clarification of timeout scope added before freeze; no prompt, allocation or scoring change.
